title: Contracting against a Non-contractible Outsider
abstract: arXiv:2509.06267v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: I study a general framework of contracting with externalities involving a non-contractible outsider. Strategic symmetry between the insider agent and the outsider is the source of multiple equilibria, even when their actions are strategic substitutes. To tackle strategic uncertainty, the principal guarantees a unique equilibrium outcome. A novel duality approach reformulates her problem as the choice of a series of agent expectations about outsider behavior, one for each agent action. The key constraint comes from eliminating undesired equilibria: she cannot convince the agent to expect higher incentives than those generated by the outsider's best responses to the actions she has already conquered. To reduce strategic rents, the principal optimally induces attenuated agent incentives. translated_title: 与不可缔约局外人的博弈契约设计
translated_abstract: 本文研究了一个涉及不可缔约局外人的、带有外部性的一般契约设计框架。内部代理人（insider agent）与局外人（outsider）之间的策略对称性是多重均衡的根源，即使二者的行动是策略替代关系。为了应对策略不确定性，委托人（principal）需要保证实现唯一的均衡结果。本文提出一种新颖的对偶方法，将委托人的问题重新表述为对一系列代理人关于局外人行为的预期的选择，即每个代理人行动对应一个预期。关键约束来自于消除不希望出现的均衡：委托人无法说服代理人期待比局外人对她已“征服”的行动所做出的最优反应所产生的激励更高的激励。为了减少策略租金，委托人会最优地诱导出被削弱的代理人激励。在超模或亚模环境中，委托人的协调能力与承诺能力在决定契约结果上互为替代品……
tldr: 本文提出一种新颖的对偶方法来研究委托人在面对不可缔约局外人时的契约设计问题，证明了为消除不利均衡、减少策略租金，委托人会最优地削弱代理人激励，且其协调能力与承诺能力在决定契约结果上互为替代。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a novel duality approach to contracting against a non-contractible outsider, showing that to eliminate undesired equilibria and reduce strategic rents, the principal optimally attenuates agent incentives, and her coordination power and commitment power are substitutes in determining the contracting outcome.
